audit_items.proof_trace: The proposer indices cache is keyed only on state root at epoch boundary (line 540), not on the complete set of inputs to proposer computation (active validator set, randao mix, epoch). If two states share the same root at the cache key slot but differ in validator effective balances or randao state, they will incorrectly share cached proposer indices, violating determinism.
audit_items.attack_scenario: An attacker exploits a state transition where validator effective balances change between epochs but the state root at the cache key slot remains identical due to hash aliasing or delayed state updates. When PrecomputeProposerIndices is called for the new epoch, it retrieves stale proposer indices from cache (line 554-556 early return), causing consensus participants to disagree on the proposer sequence.
